title: Whole-house Rhino pressure drops below 30 psi
shortDescription: Aquasana Rhino EQ-1000 outlet pressure significantly lower than inlet.
fullDescription: When the carbon and KDF media beds become exhausted or compressed they restrict flow. Pressure drop greater than 15 psi across the housing means it is time to replace the pre-filter and check the post-filter.

fixSteps.title: Bypass system
fixSteps.instruction: Turn the bypass valve to confirm pressure returns when system is bypassed.

fixSteps.title: Replace pre-filter
fixSteps.instruction: Shut inlet, depressurize, swap the 5-micron sediment cartridge, restore flow.

whenToCallPro: If main tank pressure drop persists after pre/post replacement.

title: Bypass valve weeping
shortDescription: O-ring on the brass bypass weeping after toggling.
fullDescription: The bypass valve uses two O-rings that can dry out and crack. Leaks usually appear after a service event when the valve is toggled. Replace the O-ring kit.

fixSteps.title: Shut inlet
fixSteps.instruction: Close the upstream shutoff and relieve pressure.

fixSteps.title: Replace O-rings
fixSteps.instruction: Disassemble bypass, swap both O-rings, lubricate with silicone grease.

faq.a: Silicone only - petroleum grease destroys EPDM.

title: Under-sink AQ-5300+ flow drops
shortDescription: Three-stage under-sink filter flow below half a gallon per minute.
fullDescription: AQ-5300+ uses three Claryum cartridges. When the indicator turns red the rated capacity has been reached and flow slows noticeably.

fixSteps.title: Replace cartridges
fixSteps.instruction: Shut inlet, twist out all three cartridges, install new ones, prime for 5 minutes.

title: Drip at cartridge head after replacement
shortDescription: Cartridge not seated fully into manifold.
fullDescription: AQ-5300+ uses twist-lock cartridges. If the cartridge is rotated less than 45 degrees the head O-ring will drip. Always twist until the indicator dot aligns.

fixSteps.title: Re-seat cartridges
fixSteps.instruction: Push up and twist clockwise until aligned.

title: Carbon taste or odor passing through
shortDescription: Chlorine or sulfur smell at fixtures despite Rhino being installed.
fullDescription: Carbon needs contact time. After install, run 5-10 minutes of cold water to flush carbon dust and stagnant water. If odor persists past initial flush, the post-filter may be missing or the main tank media is exhausted.

fixSteps.title: Flush
fixSteps.instruction: Run cold water at the tub for 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Verify flow direction
fixSteps.instruction: Check that arrows on housings point downstream.

whenToCallPro: If tank media is exhausted (10-year cycle).

title: AQ-4000 countertop no flow
shortDescription: Diverter valve in countertop unit clogged or seized.
fullDescription: The AQ-4000 sits on the counter and uses a diverter on the faucet aerator. If the diverter clogs with mineral deposits, flow stops. Soak the diverter in vinegar.

fixSteps.title: Vinegar soak
fixSteps.instruction: Remove diverter and soak in white vinegar 30 minutes.

title: AQ-4100 shower filter low flow
fullDescription: The AQ-4100 in-shower KDF cartridge is rated for 6 months or 10,000 gallons. When exhausted the media compacts and flow slows.

fixSteps.title: Replace cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew the housing, swap the AQ-4105 cartridge, reinstall.

faq.a: Yes - KDF reduces chlorine, not hardness.

title: Blue-green stains in fixtures after install
shortDescription: Acidic water leaching copper from pipes.
fullDescription: Carbon filtration can lower pH slightly. If the home already has acidic water, the combined effect can leach copper and cause blue-green staining. Add a calcite neutralizer downstream.

fixSteps.title: Install neutralizer
fixSteps.instruction: Have plumber add a calcite tank downstream of the Rhino.

faq.a: It can amplify pre-existing low pH.

title: Optional UV add-on lamp fault
shortDescription: UV-Flow Sense lamp end-of-life or quartz sleeve fouled.
fullDescription: Aquasana's optional UV add-on includes a lamp life counter. After 9000 hours the controller alarms and the relay opens to prevent untreated water from passing.

fixSteps.title: Replace lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Shut inlet, remove top cap, swap UV lamp, reset hour counter.

title: Brown water after main shutoff
shortDescription: Sediment surge after city work or pump cycle.
fullDescription: After a city water main flush or well pump restart, sediment can overwhelm the pre-filter. Replace the pre-filter and run cold water at the tub for several minutes to clear the line.

fixSteps.title: Flush tub cold
fixSteps.instruction: Run cold tub spout for 10 minutes.

whenToCallPro: If brown water persists past pre-filter swap.

faq.a: Tank may need flushing - separate task.
